items.promptText: What does the vehicle cost Malik each month in total?
What share of Malik’s $2,840 take-home pay does the vehicle take? Give one decimal place.
What share would the $389 payment alone have suggested? Give one decimal place.
What do housing, food, and utilities come to each month?
What is left each month once those commitments and the vehicle are paid?
By how much does that fall short of the $450 savings goal?
Across the 60 months of the loan, how much saving does that monthly shortfall represent?
Which figure most fairly answers the question "can Malik afford this vehicle?"
